frontmatter.goal: Create and grow a Substack newsletter on urban balcony gardening with both free and paid content tiers

content.title: Urban Balcony Gardening Substack Newsletter
content.body: Launch a Substack newsletter focused on urban balcony gardening, sharing personal experiences and knowledge about growing vegetables in apartment settings. The newsletter will begin with free content covering fundamentals and eventually introduce a paid tier for premium guides and personalized advice.
